blocks.title: Crystallization ka usool
blocks.text: Solute munasib solvent mein zyada darja hararat par halne wala ho, aur solution thanda karne par izafi solute crystals ke taur par bahar aa jaye.

items: Yeh apne boiling point par madde ki bari miqdar aur kamre ke darja hararat par sirf thori miqdar hal kare.
Yeh solute se kimiyai taur par react na kare.
Yeh ya to na-pakiyan hal na kare, ya na-pakiyan us se solute ke saath crystallize na hon.
Thanda hone par yeh khalis compound ke achhe bane crystals jama kare.
Yeh sasta, istemal mein mehfooz aur aasani se hatane wala ho.

blocks.text: Sab se zyada istemal hone wale solvents pani, absolute ethanol, chloroform, carbon tetrachloride aur acetic acid hain; agar koi munasib na ho to do ya zyada milne wale solvents ka milap istemal ho sakta hai. Agar solvent aag pakarne wala ho to solution water bath par garam kiya jata hai taake aag na lage. Agar garam filtration ke doran crystals nikalne lagein to woh filter paper ya funnel band kar dete hain; hot-water funnel is se bachata hai.

blocks.prompt: Khaam product ko crystallize karne ki zaroorat kyun hai, aur munasib solvent kaise chuna jata hai (exercise Q.2a; Quick Check 15.2a, b; Q.4)?
blocks.explanation: Khaam product mein bina react hua khaam maal aur by-products hote hain; crystallization inhen mother liquor mein chhor kar khalis solid deti hai. Solvent yun chuna jata hai ke compound garam mein khoob aur thande mein thora hale, us se react na kare, na-pakiyan ya to bina hale ya solution mein chhore, achhe crystals de, aur sasta, mehfooz aur aasani se hatane wala ho; pani, ethanol, chloroform, carbon tetrachloride aur acetic acid aam intikhab hain.

items: Crystallization: garam hal karein, thanda kar ke crystals nikalein. Behtareen solvent: garam mein zyada solute, thande mein kam; koi reaction nahi; na-pakiyan peechhe; achhe crystals; sasta, mehfooz, hatane wala (pani, ethanol, chloroform, CCl4, acetic acid; mile solvents; aag pakarne wale solvents ke liye water bath; hot-water funnel).
